en.askTitle: Put in your own degree, funds and offers to get the same rules-checked Canada study plan, with a clear stop point
en.runTitle: Manila to Canada: a two-year business postgraduate programme on CAD 70,000

fields.label: Intake and province
fields.value: September 2027, public college or university in Ontario or British Columbia

fields.label: Family funds available
fields.value: About CAD 70,000 for the whole programme, including living costs

fields.label: Programme offers and fees
fields.placeholder: e.g. a master’s offer at CAD 6,700 per term

fields.label: Confirmed funding and payment dates
fields.placeholder: e.g. a fellowship of CAD 10,000 paid in two instalments

en.template: Help me compare Canada study options for {intake}, with {degree}, {english}, {research}, {funds}, {offers} and {funding}. Separate tuition, living costs, upfront cash and reserves. Keep fellowship separate from wages, flag permit and PGWP questions, and tell me when to pause. Plan only; do not apply, contact, pay or book.

phases.title: Check study-permit and work-permit rules on official government pages, and find real programmes
phases.note: Attestation letters, the cap, proof of funds, and which programmes qualify for a work permit
phases.judgment: It separated what is confirmed from what is only this year’s rule: a public master’s degree avoids the attestation letter, a postgraduate diploma does not, and 2026 provincial allocations were not presented as confirmed September 2027 rules. It noted that no 2027 announcement could be found.

phases.title: Look up programme tuition and city living costs
Write the plan and source list, then check the page once at the end
phases.judgment: The bottom line is stated plainly: CAD 70,000 is not enough for the unfunded 24-month options it modelled. Only Brock could fit, at about CAD 67,615, and only with a confirmed fellowship and a 20-month finish. It also records that it could not fully confirm the research was done in a fresh, signed-out browser.

workers: Researched five real programmes in Ontario and British Columbia: fees, length, entry requirements and whether graduates can get a work permit
Read the official government rules on attestation letters, the study-permit cap, proof of funds, biometrics, medical exams and fees

zh.askTitle: 填上你自己的学历、资金和录取情况，得到一份规则核对过、有明确停手点的加拿大留学方案
zh.runTitle: 马尼拉到加拿大：用 7 万加元读两年商科研究生项目

fields.label: 入学时间和省份
fields.value: 2027 年 9 月入学，安大略省或不列颠哥伦比亚省的公立学院或大学

fields.label: 学历、成绩和数理基础
fields.value: 马尼拉的工商管理学士（BS Business Administration）

fields.label: 英语证明
fields.placeholder: 例如：雅思总分 7.0，2026 年考的

fields.label: 家庭可用资金
fields.value: 整个项目（含生活费）约 7 万加元

fields.label: 课程录取及费用
fields.placeholder: 例如：硕士录取，每学期学费 6,700 加元

fields.label: 已确认资助及到账日期
fields.placeholder: 例如：1 万加元奖学金，分两次发放

zh.template: 请按{intake}、{degree}、{english}、{research}、{funds}、{offers}和{funding}，帮我比较加拿大留学选择。分清学费、生活费、前期现金和储备，把 fellowship 与工资分开，提醒我学签和 PGWP 要核对什么，以及什么时候该停一停。只做计划，不申请、不联系、不付款、不预订。

phases.title: 在官方网页核对学签和工签规则，并找真实项目
phases.note: 省级证明信、名额上限、资金证明，以及哪些项目符合工签条件
phases.judgment: 它把已经确认的和只是今年的规则分开写：公立大学的硕士学位项目不需要省级证明信，研究生文凭则需要；2026 年的省级名额也没有被当成 2027 年 9 月的确定规则，并注明没有找到 2027 年的公布。

phases.title: 查项目学费和各城市的生活费
写方案和来源清单，最后统一检查一次页面
phases.judgment: 结论直说了：7 万加元不够读它测算的无资助 24 个月项目。只有 Brock 能放得下，约 67,615 加元，而且前提是拿到确认的奖学金、并在 20 个月内读完。它还如实记下，调研过程没有完全验证过是在干净环境里进行的。

workers: 研究了安大略和不列颠哥伦比亚的五个真实项目：学费、学制、入学要求，以及毕业后能不能拿到工作许可
阅读官方规则：省级证明信、学签名额上限、资金证明、生物信息采集、体检和各项费用
